purpose: The Stage-5 closure contract: every property Stage 5 must establish, the harness that establishes it on the EXACT Axon + MiCode pair, and the skips that are outside Stage 5. Consumed by scripts/v022_stage5_verify.sh (which executes it) and scripts/release_check.sh --stage v022-stage5 (which checks a receipt against it). For a REQUIRED harness, SKIP and NOT_RUN are failures of Stage-5 certification. This profile does NOT redefine AXON_HARNESS_STRICT; repository-wide strict qualification keeps its own meaning.

harnesses.establishes: Axon-side exact tests for every Stage-5 registry row (G03/G08/G10/G11/G13/G28/G32), B256 adapter negotiation, G3 intake join, and the Fabric omissions regression

Real MiCode <-> real Axon: B268 policy consumption and single-owner refusal, B269 episode export/intake, G3 (real MiCode -> real axon-fabric -> real interpreter -> real axon-loop intake) and B256 (real MiCode negotiating with the real cortex-policy-adapter before any model call). Discriminates: a pre-G3 MiCode (0f5329f8) fails every G3 assertion; a lazily negotiating MiCode (f926dbf8) fails 9/11 B256 assertions.

cases.why: lazy B256 MiCode (negotiates on first decision, writes no profile record)

harnesses.establishes: The real-system sections DISCRIMINATE: the same gate, run against MiCode builds that lack the property, must FAIL that section. Built from the MiCode repository in throwaway worktrees at the pinned revisions; a gate that passed those builds would prove nothing.
MiCode halves of B256 (negotiation), B261 (WorkspaceVersion vector), the -0 cross-implementation rule, and G3 (the Fabric acceptance-check client's refusal paths)
B268 single policy-adoption owner (TWO_POLICY_ADOPTION_OWNERS) and policy/context refusals on the real MiCode binary

The MiCode workspace suite as a REGRESSION baseline for the pair, reported separately from the Stage-5 requirements as PASS, PASS_WITH_KNOWN_BASELINE_DEFECTS (only the declared defects failed, exactly as fingerprinted, each re-reproduced on its pinned baseline this run) or FAIL. pytest is a PREREQUISITE: its absence is NOT_RUN, which fails the profile.

result_semantics.FAIL: executed and the property failed, or evidence is missing
result_semantics.SKIP: the harness reported a skip; for a required harness a Stage-5 FAILURE
result_semantics.NOT_RUN: a prerequisite or the peer is absent; for a required harness a Stage-5 FAILURE
result_semantics.PASS_WITH_KNOWN_BASELINE_DEFECTS: the MiCode regression suite failed EXACTLY on declared pre-existing defects: same test id, same failure class, same normalized signature, the declared count, and each still reproducing on its pinned baseline revision in this run. Known defects are counted separately and never as passes. Anything else is FAIL.
result_semantics.quantities: stage5_required (PASS|FAIL), micode_full_suite (PASS|PASS_WITH_KNOWN_BASELINE_DEFECTS|FAIL) and stage5_verdict (VERIFIED|NOT_VERIFIED) are reported independently
